subject.title: fix(security): exclude test files from plugin code-safety scans (#82469)

question: Should deep installed-skill `skills.code_safety` scans also skip test-named files, or should this fix be limited to plugin `plugins.code_safety` scans?
rationale: The current diff changes a shared security-audit helper, so accepting it decides a broader scan boundary than the plugin-focused bug requires.

options.title: Narrow to plugin scans
options.body: Thread an option through `getCodeSafetySummary` and pass `excludeTestFiles: true` only from `collectPluginsCodeSafetyFindings`, preserving current installed-skill coverage.

options.title: Accept broader skill exclusion
options.body: Keep the shared-helper change only if security owners intentionally accept the installed-skill coverage change and require proof for that broader behavior.

options.title: Pause for audit-scope policy
options.body: Hold this PR until the canonical issue settles whether test-file exclusion, string masking, or another scanner policy should be the permanent fix.

recommendation.title: Narrow to plugin scans
recommendation.body: Thread an option through `getCodeSafetySummary` and pass `excludeTestFiles: true` only from `collectPluginsCodeSafetyFindings`, preserving current installed-skill coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent security-audit hardening work makes this the strongest history signal for the scan-boundary decision.
